title: Brand AI-Readiness Audit Report
description: Frozen output contract for the entrypoint (audit-orchestrator). A strict superset of the Round-3 handout floor: every field the handout requires is required here; the extra fields are additive and optional-to-consume.

audited_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. The ONLY non-deterministic field in the report.

top_priorities.description: Ordered finding ids the non-expert should act on first.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'F-001'. Deterministic: assigned by the orchestrator in a fixed sort order.

evidence.description: Concrete, reproducible measurement: URLs, counts, ratios, exact missing fields, quoted text.

detail.description: Optional implementation-level fix, specific enough to act on without further research.

layer.description: Which gate this finding belongs to. Additive.

check_id.description: The catalogue check that produced it, e.g. 'L1-01'. Enables traceability and the stable-id hash.

confidence.description: confirmed = directly observed; probable = inferred from a sample; advisory = best-practice, no defect observed.

audit_meta.description: Additive provenance so a reader can trust and reproduce the run.

checks_passed.description: Checks that ran and found no defect. Reporting these demonstrates coverage, not just failures.

checks_skipped.description: Checks that could not run (e.g. no headless browser), each with a reason. Never silently pass.

robots_compliance.description: Statement that the audit itself honoured robots.txt and crawl-delay while fetching.
